title: AEW gate correction
description: ITEMS 55 (operator, option (b), 2026-11-01; designer, addenda 2 to 4): a Story's or Epic's mandatory gate that can never be satisfied, replaced on the record by one that can (the typed `resolve` tool, choice `replace_gate`). Written once, immutable, beside the unit (`work/<S>/gate-corrections/<GC>.yaml`) and pointed to from its control-state policy. The unit's own record is never rewritten.

work_unit.description: The Story or Epic whose mandatory gate was replaced.

replaced.description: The gate that could never be satisfied.

with.description: The gate that carries its standard, which passes the predicate.

by.description: The actor: the Lead, or the operator through the Lead seat.

generation.description: The Lead generation that replaced it.

expected_revision.description: The control revision the write expected (an expected-revision write).

rev.description: The control revision the replacement committed.

stale_invocations.description: Every descendant invocation that was active, whose context pack the replacement changed, with the commands that re-dispatch it (addendum 3).
